cards.question: Why can scoped threads borrow local variables?
cards.answer: They finish before the scope exits, so the borrowed data outlives the threads.

cards.question: When are scoped threads joined?
cards.answer: All threads spawned in the std::thread::scope callback are joined before the scope function exits.

cards.question: Can two scoped threads mutate the same local?
cards.answer: No. Multiple read references are allowed, but only one mutable reference at a time — not one mutable plus readers.
